lines.text:
I’m a huge fan of Lt. Surge, the Vermilion
City Gym Leader!\c
What?! You have his autograph?!
Oh, wow, I’m super jealous!

Oh, wow! You’re [VAR TRNAME(0000)], right...?
The Champion?\c
D-d-do you think maybe you could give me
your autograph?!
Lorelei of the Elite Four is just so cool!\nShe could freeze me solid with her icy gaze!
Whoa, hey there, Champion!\c\nYou’ve gotta be something if you were able\nto defeat Lorelei!
I really admire Bruno of the Elite Four.\nHe’s a Fighting-type expert and super buff, too!
Congrats on becoming Champion!\c\nYou gotta tell me, though... What was it like\nseeing Bruno’s muscles up close and in person?!
Nobody knows who the Gym Leader of\nthe Viridian City Gym is!\c\nIt’s like a mystery! I’m so curious!

So the Gym Leader of Viridian City was
the Team Rocket leader, huh...\c
But you defeated even a scary person like that!
You can count me as one of your fans now!
